title: Inventory Attributes - Introduction

children: This topic will describe what inventory attributes are, and where they are used throughout the system.
The following is discussed in this topic:

Inventory Attributes represent values that are assigned to inventory, typically when it is checked into the warehouse. These attributes fill the need to track specific information about warehouse inventory.  Typically, this type of information would need to be captured  during receipt check in, maintained in inventory, items allocated and picked based on these attributes, and then uploaded to your ERP system.  Also, you can add/edit these attributes to inventory at select places in the system. Examples of inventory attributes include such values as Country of Origin, Region, or Product Owner. The system supports inventory attributes for both license plate and non-license plate tracked locations. All of the functional areas that support inventory attributes are listed in the

All of the inventory attributes are stored in a separate database table called LOCATION_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTES. The application supports twenty attribute fields, which are generically named Inventory Attribute 01, Inventory Attribute 02, etc. You can rename these attribute field names in the System Text Editor to reflect the specific attribute being captured, such as Country of Origin, Tax Seal, or Product Owner. Also pre-defined inventory attribute values can be created in the configurations that allow you to select from these values on certain processing screens. For this list of values to be displayed onscreen, they first need to be activated (per attribute) in the configurations.
SCALE supports inventory attributes in the functional areas listed below:
This is the only method that supports capturing attributes during receiving.
Both locating with and without work are supported.
Customizations are required to locate based on specific attribute values.
Both full screen and RF work putaway is supported with attributes.
Overriding the putaway location is supported with attributes from both full screen and RF.
Supported during RF Pick and Putaway of receipt putaway work.
Location inventory with attributes can be allocated during the allocation and replenishment wave steps.  Customizations will be required to allocate or replenish based on specific attribute values.
Canceling a wave cleans up inventory based on attributes.

Allocating attributes works similar to what it does for lot controlled shipment details without the lot ID.  The system allocates based on each location inventory record at the location.  If you request 15 EA and the location has 5 EA of attribute A, 5 EA of attribute B and 5 EA without attributes, then the system allocates all three regardless the attributes. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values.

Picking into a shipping container is the only method of linking attributes to a shipping container.  It does not matter if it is a full pallet (case) or loose container or whether the container was created in the wave or during picking.  In all cases, the link is established during the RF pick/putaway process.
Override pick is permitted from both full screen and RF, as long as the new pick location has the same attribute values as the original pick location.
Override putaway is supported with attributes from both full screen and RF.

Inventory attributes are not linked on the shipping dock inventory.  This requires picking, regardless of loose or full quantity picking, to be picked into a shipping container from RF.  Since the attributes are not linked to inventory on the shipping dock manual packing does not link attributes to the container.
Attributes are uploaded with the shipping container in all interface modes.
Supported from the RF Pick and Putaway Confirmation Screens
There is a setting on the criteria page to group the results by attributes and an attribute column on the results.
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.
For Inventory Adjustment, attributes are not entered during the adjustment. After the adjustment, attributes can be updated via Inventory Insight or RF Location Inquiry
An action is available on the Inventory Insight.
A button is available to the RF Location Inquiry Screen to edit attributes.
An action is available to be added to a viewer or desktop gadget.
Cycle count creation for attributes is handled in the same manner as it is for lots.  The system creates a request for each unique set of attributes at the location.
Both full screen and RF work execution are available.  However, there is no visibility to the attributes when confirming the work.
You can add an item (lot and license plate)  with attributes from RF.
There is an exit point from RF inventory management that permits capture attributes (from a custom capture screen - see SDK).
The         Cycle Count Request Insight screen has a column in the results view for attributes, and the Cycle Count Request screen has a checkbox indicating whether the request has attributes.
Cycle count reconciliation is permitted with attributes.  As with work confirmation, there is no visibility to the attributes.
You can define location criteria for cycle count creation using attributes.

Replenishment allocates from reserve locations in the same manner as shipment allocation. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values. Note that if you want to perform replenishment based on inventory attributes that more advanced than SCALE currently offers, then you will need to customize this logic.
Replenishment override during picking and putaway is permitted in the same manner as is for inbound and outbound work.

Supported from the following screens: RF Location Inquiry, RF Inventory Management (when accessed from RF Location Inquiry), RF Cycle Count Work Execution, and RF Cycle Count Reconcile. Also supported is viewing during the RF Pick and Putaway of replenishment and inventory management work.

Attributes are written for transactions involving the adjusting of inventory during check in, locating, allocating, inventory adjustment/transfer/status change, picking, putaway, etc.  If the location inventory is linked to attributes, then the system writes the attributes as part of the history.  Since attributes are not tracked in location inventory on the shipping dock, they are not written when delivering or moving containers on the dock.
- The "Edit Inventory Attributes" action writes Inventory Attribute Change transaction history.
- The "Delete Inventory Attributes" action writes Inventory Attribute Delete transaction history.

Inventory Attributes - Introduction
        This topic will describe what inventory attributes are, and where they are used throughout the system. 
         
         
        Related Topics...
        Inventory Tracking Process Summary
        
        Using Inventory Attributes

        Activating Inventory Attribute Validation
        
         
         
        The following is discussed in this topic:
        - Inventory Attributes Defined
        - System Support for Inventory Attributes

        Inventory Attributes represent values that are assigned to inventory, typically when it is checked into the warehouse. Also, you can add/edit these attributes to inventory at select places in the system. Examples of inventory attributes include such values as Country of Origin, Region, or Product Owner. The system supports inventory attributes for both license plate and non-license plate tracked locations. All of the functional areas that support inventory attributes are listed in the System Support for Inventory Attributes section below.
         
        All of the inventory attributes are stored in a separate database table called LOCATION_INVENTORY_ATTRIBUTES. The application supports twenty attribute fields, which are generically named Inventory Attribute 01, Inventory Attribute 02, etc. You can rename these attribute field names in the System Text Editor to reflect the specific attribute being captured, such as Country of Origin, Tax Seal, or Product Owner. Also pre-defined inventory attribute values can be created in the configurations that allow you to select from these values on certain processing screens. For this list of values to be displayed onscreen, they first need to be activated (per attribute) in the configurations.

The system allocates based on each location inventory record at the location.  If you request 15 EA and the location has 5 EA of attribute A, 5 EA of attribute B and 5 EA without attributes, then the system allocates all three regardless the attributes. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values.
                         
                        
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Picking Into a 
                        Shipping Container

This requires picking, regardless of loose or full quantity picking, to be picked into a shipping container from RF.                         For Inventory Adjustment, attributes are not entered during the adjustment. After the adjustment, attributes can be updated via Inventory Insight or RF Location Inquiry
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Edit Attributes in 
                        Location Inventory
                         
                         
                         
                         
                    
                    
                         
                        An action is available on the Inventory Insight.
                         
                        A button is available to the RF Location Inquiry Screen to edit attributes.
                         
                        An action is available to be added to a viewer or desktop gadget.
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Cycle Count: Creation 
                        and Execution, Add
                        a New License Plate 
                        With Attributes
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                         
                    
                    
                                 Cycle count creation for attributes is handled in the same manner as it is for lots.  The system creates a request for each unique set of attributes at the location.

                                 You can add an item (lot and license plate)  with attributes from RF. 
                         
                         There is an exit point from RF inventory management that permits capture attributes (from a custom capture screen - see SDK).
                         
                               The         Cycle Count Request Insight screen has a column in the results view for attributes, and the Cycle Count Request screen has a checkbox indicating whether the request has attributes.  
                         
                                 Cycle count reconciliation is permitted with attributes.  As with work confirmation, there is no visibility to the attributes.  
                         
                        You can define location criteria for cycle count creation using attributes.
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Replenishment With and
                        Without Attributes
                         
                         
                         
                    
                    
                        Replenishment allocates from reserve locations in the same manner as shipment allocation. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values. Note that if you want to perform replenishment based on inventory attributes that more advanced than SCALE currently offers, then you will need to customize this logic.
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Replenishment Override
                         
                    
                    
                        Replenishment override during picking and putaway is permitted in the same manner as is for inbound and outbound work.

                        Supported from the following screens: RF Location Inquiry, RF Inventory Management (when accessed from RF Location Inquiry), RF Cycle Count Work Execution, and RF Cycle Count Reconcile. Both full screen and RF work putaway is supported with attributes.
Override Putaway
Overriding the putaway location is supported with attributes from both full screen and RF.
View Inventory Attributes
Supported during RF Pick and Putaway of receipt putaway work.

Supported Inventory Attribute Functionality
Run Wave
Location inventory with attributes can be allocated during the allocation and replenishment wave steps.  Customizations will be required to allocate or replenish based on specific attribute values.
Cancel Wave
Canceling a wave cleans up inventory based on attributes.

Allocation Based On 
                        One Attribute and 
                        Attributes Combinations

Allocating attributes works similar to what it does for lot controlled shipment details without the lot ID.  The system allocates based on each location inventory record at the location.  If you request 15 EA and the location has 5 EA of attribute A, 5 EA of attribute B and 5 EA without attributes, then the system allocates all three regardless the attributes. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values.

Picking Into a 
                        Shipping Container

Picking into a shipping container is the only method of linking attributes to a shipping container.  It does not matter if it is a full pallet (case) or loose container or whether the container was created in the wave or during picking.  In all cases, the link is established during the RF pick/putaway process.

Override Pick From 
                        a Different Location / 
                        License Plate
Override pick is permitted from both full screen and RF, as long as the new pick location has the same attribute values as the original pick location.
Override Putaway
Override putaway is supported with attributes from both full screen and RF.
Manual Packing

Inventory attributes are not linked on the shipping dock inventory.  This requires picking, regardless of loose or full quantity picking, to be picked into a shipping container from RF.  Since the attributes are not linked to inventory on the shipping dock manual packing does not link attributes to the container.
Shipment Upload Interface
Attributes are uploaded with the shipping container in all interface modes.
View Inventory Attributes
Supported from the RF Pick and Putaway Confirmation Screens

Inventory Insight–

                        Non License Plate 
                        Tracked Locations
There is a setting on the criteria page to group the results by attributes and an attribute column on the results.

Location Transfer Between 
                        Non License Plate Tracked 
                        Locations
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.

Location Transfer Between 
                        LicensePlate Tracked 
                        Locations
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.

Transfer Inventory To 
                        Another License Plate 
                        With Different Attributes
Attributes are supported, the location must be selected directly from the Inventory Insight or the RF Location Inquiry screen.
Inventory Adjustment
For Inventory Adjustment, attributes are not entered during the adjustment. After the adjustment, attributes can be updated via Inventory Insight or RF Location Inquiry

Edit Attributes in 
                        Location Inventory

An action is available on the Inventory Insight.
                         
                        A button is available to the RF Location Inquiry Screen to edit attributes.
                         
                        An action is available to be added to a viewer or desktop gadget.

Cycle Count: Creation 
                        and Execution, Add
                        a New License Plate 
                        With Attributes

Cycle count creation for attributes is handled in the same manner as it is for lots.  The system creates a request for each unique set of attributes at the location.
                         
                                 Both full screen and RF work execution are available.  However, there is no visibility to the attributes when confirming the work. 
                         
                                 You can add an item (lot and license plate)  with attributes from RF. 
                         
                         There is an exit point from RF inventory management that permits capture attributes (from a custom capture screen - see SDK).
                         
                               The         Cycle Count Request Insight screen has a column in the results view for attributes, and the Cycle Count Request screen has a checkbox indicating whether the request has attributes.  
                         
                                 Cycle count reconciliation is permitted with attributes.  As with work confirmation, there is no visibility to the attributes.  
                         
                        You can define location criteria for cycle count creation using attributes.

Replenishment With and
                        Without Attributes

Replenishment allocates from reserve locations in the same manner as shipment allocation. You can filter location selection by inventory attribute values. Note that if you want to perform replenishment based on inventory attributes that more advanced than SCALE currently offers, then you will need to customize this logic.
Replenishment Override
Replenishment override during picking and putaway is permitted in the same manner as is for inbound and outbound work.
View Inventory Attributes

Supported from the following screens: RF Location Inquiry, RF Inventory Management (when accessed from RF Location Inquiry), RF Cycle Count Work Execution, and RF Cycle Count Reconcile. Also supported is viewing during the RF Pick and Putaway of replenishment and inventory management work.

rows.text: Area
Supported Inventory Attribute Functionality

Transaction History 
                        Messages

Attributes are written for transactions involving the adjusting of inventory during check in, locating, allocating, inventory adjustment/transfer/status change, picking, putaway, etc.  If the location inventory is linked to attributes, then the system writes the attributes as part of the history.  Since attributes are not tracked in location inventory on the shipping dock, they are not written when delivering or moving containers on the dock.
                         
                        Notes:
                        - The "Edit Inventory Attributes" action writes Inventory Attribute Change transaction history.
                        - The "Delete Inventory Attributes" action writes Inventory Attribute Delete transaction history.
